launch_kubernetes_jobs: launch Kubernetes jobs from a job group using the xmanager Kubernetes executor
create_kubernetes_client: create a Kubernetes client that loads in-cluster or kube config and provides a singleton API
wait_for_kubernetes_job: wait for a Kubernetes job to complete by polling its status until completion_time is set
convert_to_valid_label: convert a string label to RFC 1123 compliant format by replacing underscores with hyphens
register_kubernetes_executor: register the Kubernetes executor with the xmanager registry for async launch and handle creation
